alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 15 at 5:33AM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures in the upper 80s to the mid 90s expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas and San Diego County Coastal
Areas.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase during hot temperatures.

alerts.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 15 at 1:38AM PDT until October 15 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Elevated high tides 6.5 to 7 ft will return late this
morning, along with surf of 3 to 5 ft with sets to 6 ft.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Through this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and beach erosion. Dangerous
swimming conditions for inexperienced swimmers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will fall below 6.5 ft after
today's high tide. A long-period south swell will continue
today.
